original_prompt: Create a Kubernetes Deployment YAML manifest running 3 replicas of nginx:1.27 serving HTTP traffic on port 80 for a public-facing web frontend.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Kubernetes manifest (YAML)

Task: Create a Kubernetes Deployment YAML manifest running 3 replicas of nginx:1.27 serving HTTP traffic on port 80 for a public-facing web frontend.

Output only the Kubernetes manifest (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: web-frontend-nginx-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: web-frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: web-frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.27"
data:
  nginx.conf: |-
    worker_processes auto;
    error_log /dev/stderr warn;
    pid /var/run/nginx/nginx.pid;

    events {
      worker_connections 1024;
      multi_accept on;
    }

    http {
      include       /etc/nginx/mime.types;
      default_type  application/octet-stream;

      log_format  main  '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] "$request" '
                        '$status $body_bytes_sent "$http_referer" '
                        '"$http_user_agent" "$http_x_forwarded_for"';

      access_log  /dev/stdout  main;

      sendfile        on;
      tcp_nopush      on;
      tcp_nodelay     on;
      keepalive_timeout  65;
      types_hash_max_size 2048;
      server_tokens off;

      server {
        listen 8080 default_server;
        listen [::]:8080 default_server;
        server_name _;

        root /usr/share/nginx/html;
        index index.html;

        location / {
          try_files $uri $uri/ =404;
        }
      }
    }
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web-frontend
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: web-frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: web-frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.27"
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: web-frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
      protocol: TCP
---

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web-frontend
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: web-frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: web-frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.27"
spec:
  replicas: 3
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: web-frontend
      app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend

    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 1
      maxSurge: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: web-frontend
        app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend

    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false

      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 101
        runAsGroup: 101
        fsGroup: 101
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault

        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
            - weight: 100
              podAffinityTerm:
                labelSelector:
                  matchExpressions:
                    - key: app.kubernetes.io/name
                      operator: In
                      values: ["web-frontend"]
                    - key: app.kubernetes.io/component
                      operator: In
                      values: ["frontend"]
                topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
      topologySpreadConstraints:
        - maxSkew: 1

            - name: run

          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:

            initialDelaySeconds: 10

            failureThreshold: 3
            timeoutSeconds: 2
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:

              port: 8080
              scheme: HTTP
            failureThreshold: 30

      volumes:

        - name: cache

        - name: run
